Drawer.name: Drawer
Drawer.guideline: Open state for a side panel; renders nothing itself. Compose DrawerTrigger and DrawerPortal in children. It carries no shop state of its own.

DrawerTrigger.name: DrawerTrigger
DrawerTrigger.guideline: The button that opens the enclosing drawer. The children prop is the label. Disabled while the root has nothing to act on.

DrawerPortal.name: DrawerPortal
DrawerPortal.guideline: Moves the panel to the end of the document. Put DrawerBackdrop then DrawerViewport in children.

DrawerBackdrop.name: DrawerBackdrop
DrawerBackdrop.guideline: The layer behind the panel. Style it with fixed inset-0 and a translucent background.

DrawerViewport.name: DrawerViewport
DrawerViewport.guideline: Positions the panel and handles swipe and touch scroll locking. Put DrawerPopup inside it. Style it with fixed inset-0 and flex alignment toward the edge the panel opens from.

DrawerPopup.name: DrawerPopup
DrawerPopup.guideline: The panel itself, placed inside DrawerViewport. Children are its contents; put DrawerTitle and DrawerClose first.

DrawerTitle.name: DrawerTitle
DrawerTitle.guideline: Accessible title of the panel. Place it inside DrawerPopup.

DrawerClose.name: DrawerClose
DrawerClose.guideline: Closes the panel. Place it inside DrawerPopup.

Container.name: Container
Container.guideline: A plain box. Use the style array for layout classes (flex, grid, gap, padding).

Text.name: Text
Text.guideline: Headings and paragraphs. The children prop is the text; pick the element with as.

BookingList.name: BookingList
BookingList.guideline: One list, scoped by the nearest root: inside ClientRoot the selected client's bookings, inside BarberRoot the selected barber's, directly under ShopRoot every booking. Children are the row, repeated for each booking, and provide bookingRow. ScopeClient or ScopeBarber inside the row points a nested BookingList at that row's client or barber. Oldest first.

ClientName.name: ClientName
ClientName.guideline: The client on this booking row. Place it inside BookingList.

BarberName.name: BarberName
BarberName.guideline: The barber on this booking row. Place it inside BookingList.

BookingLabel.name: BookingLabel
BookingLabel.guideline: A row for the booking's names. Put ClientName and BarberName in children, with any text between them.

BookingTime.name: BookingTime
BookingTime.guideline: The date and start–end time of this booking row. Place it inside BookingList.

ScopeClient.name: ScopeClient
ScopeClient.guideline: Children see this row's client as the booking scope, so a BookingList inside lists that client's bookings. Place it inside BookingList.

ScopeBarber.name: ScopeBarber
ScopeBarber.guideline: Children see this row's barber as the booking scope, so a BookingList inside lists that barber's bookings. Place it inside BookingList.

CancelButton.name: CancelButton
CancelButton.guideline: Cancels this booking row. Place it inside BookingList.

ShopRoot.name: ShopRoot
ShopRoot.guideline: Holds the mocked shop: barbers, clients, bookings, and the mutations on them. Selection lives in ClientRoot and BarberRoot. The backend is not called.

ClientRoot.name: ClientRoot
ClientRoot.guideline: Scopes its children to one client. ClientPicker selects them; BookingList inside shows their bookings; AddBookingDrawer books for them.

ClientPicker.name: ClientPicker
ClientPicker.guideline: Lists clients and selects one for the enclosing ClientRoot.

AddBookingDrawer.name: AddBookingDrawer
AddBookingDrawer.guideline: A Drawer whose children also share the in-progress booking (barber, date, slot). Compose DrawerTrigger and DrawerPortal in children, with the booking fields inside DrawerPopup. The trigger is disabled until a client is selected.

BookingClient.name: BookingClient
BookingClient.guideline: Names the client the drawer will book for. Place it inside AddBookingDrawer.

BookingBarber.name: BookingBarber
BookingBarber.guideline: Chooses the barber for the booking in progress. Place it inside AddBookingDrawer.

BookingDate.name: BookingDate
BookingDate.guideline: Date of the booking in progress. Changing it clears the chosen slot. Place it inside AddBookingDrawer.

BookingSlot.name: BookingSlot
BookingSlot.guideline: Free 30-minute slots for the chosen barber and date. Place it inside AddBookingDrawer.

ConfirmBooking.name: ConfirmBooking
ConfirmBooking.guideline: Books the selected client with the barber and slot chosen in the drawer, the same inputs as bookHaircut. Closes the drawer when the booking is accepted.

BarberRoot.name: BarberRoot
BarberRoot.guideline: Scopes its children to one barber. BarberSelect selects them; BookingList inside shows their bookings; EditHoursDrawer edits their hours.

BarberSelect.name: BarberSelect
BarberSelect.guideline: Lists barbers and selects one for the enclosing BarberRoot.

EditHoursDrawer.name: EditHoursDrawer
EditHoursDrawer.guideline: A Drawer whose children also share the range being added (weekday, start, end). Compose DrawerTrigger and DrawerPortal in children, with the hours fields inside DrawerPopup. The trigger is disabled until a barber is selected.

HoursBarber.name: HoursBarber
HoursBarber.guideline: Names the barber whose hours the drawer edits. Place it inside EditHoursDrawer.

HoursList.name: HoursList
HoursList.guideline: The selected barber's weekly hours, each with a Remove button. Place it inside EditHoursDrawer.

HoursWeekday.name: HoursWeekday
HoursWeekday.guideline: Weekday of the range being added. Place it inside EditHoursDrawer.

HoursStart.name: HoursStart
HoursStart.guideline: Start time of the range being added. Place it inside EditHoursDrawer.

HoursEnd.name: HoursEnd
HoursEnd.guideline: End time of the range being added. Place it inside EditHoursDrawer.

AddHours.name: AddHours
AddHours.guideline: Appends the draft range to the selected barber. Rejects reversed or overlapping ranges, like setBarberHours. Place it inside EditHoursDrawer.
